translated_title: Second State of the Nation Report: A Paradigm Shift
author: La Jornada Editorial Board
meta_description: La Jornada's editorial on Claudia Sheinbaum's second State of the Nation Report: verifiable data—homicides down 51%, the minimum wage up 154% in real terms, Well-Being programs reaching 42.8 million—mark a shift from free-market dogma to a social economy.
